card.name: Start of ritonavir after a slash
card.fires_on: The piece "rit" at the start of ritonavir right after a slash in boosted protease inhibitor pairs such as lopinavir/ritonavir. Also fires on a few other word-internal pieces in long or rare names.

modes.label: Ritonavir after slash
modes.description: The first piece of ritonavir following a drug name and a slash in combination names.
modes.example: Lopinavir/<<rit>>onavir is an inhibitor of C

modes.label: Other broken-up names
modes.description: Odd pieces inside a hyphenated medical term or a brand or place name.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing the word with the following letters (such as "onavir") and away from endings like "ine".
card.plain: It lights up on the first letters of ritonavir when it follows a slash after another HIV drug name.
